name: Crack a fetch on turn 1-2 for a non-basic land that unlocks a hand card
intent: On turn 1 or 2, once open-land-unlocks, open-shock-unlocks and open-fetch-unlocks have all had first refusal, play a fetch from hand and crack it for a library land that unlocks some other hand card even though that land is not a basic - Arid Mesa reaching a second Sacred Foundry once the library's own basic Mountain and Plains are gone. Item 2 (2026-09-14 review batch): open-fetch-unlocks' own true key narrowed from unlocks_by_search to unlocks_by_basic_search, fixing the regression where it cracked Marsh Flats for a library Sacred Foundry (3 life total) with Arid Mesa sitting in the same hand able to reach a free basic Mountain instead - but that narrowing leaves boros-aggro with no play at all for a hand whose only fetch reach is itself non-basic. This lane closes that gap, priced correctly: it pays the fetch's own 1 life to crack plus the found land's own optional 2, strictly worse than either open-land-unlocks (free) or open-shock-unlocks (one payment only) - so it stands down whenever either of those, or open-fetch-unlocks itself (which would find a free basic instead), already would. The choose_cards pick shares open-fetch-unlocks' own basic-first, life-last prefer order - this deck has only one non-basic unlocking land shape (a shockland carrying both its colours), so no missing-subtype tier is needed the way prowess's own scarcer-colour fetch-shock lane reads one. Only turns 1-2, land drop available, mine, precombat main, empty stack.
